source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Let’s go with standard 120V wall outlet for now.

I want to keep the first version as simple and reliable as possible for events. We can always explore battery power in a later version.

Everything sounds good on my end — excited to get this going. Let me know what you need from me as you start the CAD and BOM.

routing_warnings.description: The upgraded 50A AC/DC adapter and higher-rated controllers address internal capacity and overheating margin, not the external 120V wall-power choice.
The statement about turning the machine on and off by plugging it into the wall concerns the absence and proposed placement of a main power control, not a new wall-power lifecycle transition.
